label: EX2300-48P PoE+ 48-port 1G access switch
description: Juniper EX2300-48P 1RU PoE+ access switch: 48x 10/100/1000BASE-T RJ-45, all 48 PSE ports at 802.3af/802.3at up to 30 W each on a 740 W budget, 4x 1G/10G SFP/SFP+ uplinks (xe-0/1/0-3), 1x RJ-45 out-of-band management port, RJ-45 serial and mini-USB Type B console, 176 Gbps packet-switching capacity, 130 Mpps, 100 W input power with no PoE load, 850 W fixed supply, image 15.1X53-D55 or later.

poe.note: 740 W from an 850 W fixed supply per the power-supply table, the system-overview table and the datasheet, which spells the arithmetic out: 15.4 W of 802.3af Class 3 to 48 ports (739.2 W), or 30 W of 802.3at to 24 ports. Juniper's PoE User Guide Table 5 lists this switch at 750 W instead - see the PR body; three documents agree on 740 W and 48 x 15.4 W lands on 739.2 W, so 740 W is what is modelled.

fabric.note: 176 Gbps bidirectional, 130 Mpps. The per-model 'AC Max Power Consumption' row shows 740 W, which is the PoE budget rather than a separate system draw - 100 W is the no-PoE figure.

notes: 48 PoE+ RJ-45 ports with no non-PoE copper, 4 SFP+ uplinks, 2 console ports, 1 RJ-45 management port, 1 USB Type A. 12.2 in / 30.98 cm deep, 5.02 kg, two fixed front-to-back fans, 51.4 dB - the loudest of the four 1G models. 802.3af/at only.
